extensions.grants.dialog.body:
Extension code runs in the same process as other extensions, with no isolation between them. Any enabled extension can technically use the permissions granted here. Only enable plugins you trust.

Read: the titles, status and full conversations of all sessions, including tool output. Write: create, fork, send messages to, interrupt, rename, open, archive and pin any session on this computer. If the target session runs in full access mode, a message from the plugin makes the Agent run tools directly.

Sessions in the plugin's project: the plugin can also approve or deny tool calls for you, answer the Agent's questions and switch the permission mode.

Actions started by a plugin show their source and are written to the audit log.
extensions.grants.dialog.fullAccessBody: Full access: the plugin can switch sessions in its project to full access, so the Agent reads and writes files, runs commands and uses the network without asking. Only grant this to plugins you trust.
extensions.grants.dialog.notificationsBo: System notifications: the plugin can show system notifications while the window is in the background, with the plugin name before the title.
